title: Acetaminophen maximum dose
text: Acetaminophen (paracetamol): the maximum recommended dose for healthy adults is 4,000 mg per day, that is 4 grams in any 24 hours. Source: FDA prescribing information.

title: Ibuprofen in pregnancy
text: Ibuprofen and other NSAIDs should be avoided from about 20 weeks of pregnancy onward, because they can cause fetal kidney problems. Source: FDA Drug Safety Communication.

title: Warfarin INR target
text: For most patients taking warfarin, the target INR range is 2.0 to 3.0. Source: ACCP antithrombotic guideline.

title: Metformin and kidney function
text: Metformin is contraindicated when the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) is below 30 mL/min/1.73m2, due to the risk of lactic acidosis. Source: FDA prescribing information.
